title: Privileged changeflow for batch/cache recommendation apply and replayable rollback
creator: Ami Patel
description: Problem: The batch/caching advisor proposes automated configuration changes to reduce token cost. We need a hardened, auditable changeflow for auto-apply + safe rollback that meets enterprise compliance: role-gated approvals, immutable forensic logs, tamper-evident replay, and live-config reconciliation. Scope: design and implement an RBAC-protected change conductor, store signed change bundles, emit structured audit events, and a deterministic rollback path that can be replayed in the private and dedicated product tiers.
acceptance_criteria: Only principals with the configured 'cost:apply' permission can execute a live apply; attempts are denied and logged otherwise
Every apply produces a signed change bundle persisted to the audit store with the actor, policy id, proposed diffs, before/after hashes, and commit timestamp
Rollback API accepts a change bundle id and performs a reversible apply that restores previous runtime and records a rollback-audit entry
All audit events are queryable from Console (per-route, per-model) and exportable to customer SIEM via syslog/CloudWatch/Stackdriver
Automated policies can be scheduled but require attestation from either: an approved service principal, a human approver, or a cross-account signed key depending on customer tenancy
Unit and integration tests cover positive and negative RBAC paths, conflict detection, and recovery from partial failures
proposed_solution: Introduce a Change Conductor service that mediates all cost-suggester applies. It validates requester JWT and checks RBAC via the existing authz service, snapshots current runtime config, computes a deterministic reorder-safe diff, signs the bundle with a service key, stores it in the immutable audit store, and triggers the runtime apply through the deployment API. Rollback will be implemented as a replay of the inverse diff from the signed bundle. Console will surface a change timeline and allow trace links to infra logs and PRs.
design_decisions: Use existing authz policies and add two fine-grained permissions: cost:proposal:apply and cost:proposal:approve
Persist change bundles to the append-only audit store (s3 with write-once lifecycle + KMS envelope) to meet tamper-evidence requirements
Sign bundles with HSM-backed key (KMS/HSM integration) and store signature in metadata to enable forensic verification
Define structured audit event schema (RFC-like) to ensure consistent parsing by SIEMs
Adopt eventual consistency for rollout across Dedicated nodes with staged canary and verification steps; require explicit canary approval for high-risk customers
rbac_roles: cost:proposal:create - allowed for suggestion service principal and analysts
cost:proposal:apply - allowed for SREs, Platform Ops, and customer-approved service principals
cost:proposal:approve - required for auto-scheduled high-impact changes; allowed for engineering leads and customer approvers
cost:proposal:rollback - allowed for SREs with incident role and platform audits team
rollback_plan: Rollback is initiated by calling POST /v1/change/{bundle_id}/rollback, authenticated and authorized via authz service
Conductor verifies bundle integrity and signature, computes inverse diffs and collision checks, and runs apply on a canary node first
If canary passes health checks, conductor applies across remaining nodes; partial failure triggers automatic retry with exponential backoff and a failure audit
If rollback fails repeatedly, conductor opens an incident and escalates to on-call SRE with a link to the bundle and diffs
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Internal dogfood in staging with a single test org and synthetic traffic (2 weeks)
Phase 2: Beta with opt-in enterprise tenants and manual approvers (4 weeks)
Phase 3: Gradual enablement for Dedicated/Private customers with default off for Hosted, plus console controls (2 weeks)
Gate: Security review and sign-off required before Phase 2. Compliance checklist must be green.
testing_notes: Unit tests for signer/verification; fuzz test malformed bundles
Integration tests that simulate network partition and ensure rollback idempotency
E2E test: create suggestion -> approve -> apply -> validate metric delta -> rollback -> validate metrics restored
Load test: 100 concurrent bundle creates and 10 concurrent applies to validate conductor throughput
observability_and_alerting: Emit structured traces through tracing service with span 'change.conductor.apply'
Dashboard: change success/failure rate, avg apply latency, canary pass rate
Alert: >5% apply failure rate in 10m window OR any missing audit signature
Audit log export integration with customer SIEM via syslog and S3 delivery
